title: Diesel Generator Set

introduction.definition: A diesel generator set is a complete power unit on a skid: a compression-ignition diesel engine drives an alternator through a flywheel, with radiator, base-frame fuel tank, exhaust silencer and a controller. It provides standby, prime or continuous power.
applications: Standby power for hospitals, data centres, plants
Prime power at remote sites and mines
key_points: Automatic start on mains failure (with ATS)

classification.type: Diesel genset, inline-6, turbocharged, base-frame fuel tank

introduction.summary: A diesel generator set (genset) is a complete power plant on a skid: a diesel engine (compression ignition — fuel is injected into hot compressed air and ignites by itself) drives an alternator through a flywheel. Radiator, fuel tank in the base frame, exhaust silencer and a controller make it self-contained for prime, continuous or standby (emergency) power.

foundation: Level concrete plinth; anti-vibration mounts between engine/alternator and base.
alignment: Align driver and driven shafts with a laser or dial-indicator method to the coupling maker's tolerances; re-check hot alignment where thermal growth is significant.
piping: Exhaust with flexible bellows, silencer and rain cap away from air intakes; radiator air discharge ducted out.
Fuel supply/return with day tank and bund.
commissioning: Check rotation direction with the coupling disconnected.
Fill lubricant to the correct level and grade.
Start unloaded where possible; record vibration, temperatures, current and pressures as a baseline.

routine.task: Weekly no-load test run; monthly load test.

periodic.task: Change engine oil and filters; check belts and battery.

overhaul.task: Engine top/major overhaul; alternator bearing replacement.

lubrication: Engine oil per maker (API/ACEA class); alternator bearings greased or sealed.

causes: Fuel air-lock, weak battery, low fuel

script.narration: This module introduces the Diesel Generator Set.

A diesel generator set is a complete power unit on a skid: a compression-ignition diesel engine drives an alternator through a flywheel, with radiator, base-frame fuel tank, exhaust silencer and a controller.
It provides standby, prime or continuous power.
Typical applications include standby power for hospitals, data centres, plants; prime power at remote sites and mines; emergency fire-pump and safety systems; construction and events (rental).
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Flywheel, Alternator – Rotor: 4 Salient Poles with Field Coils, Exciter Armature & Rotating Rectifier.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Diesel Generator Set — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Diesel Generator Set.
Weekly no-load test run; monthly load test.
Check coolant, oil, fuel, battery.
Change engine oil and filters; check belts and battery.
Measure generator insulation resistance.
Engine top/major overhaul; alternator bearing replacement.
Watch for fails to start: cranks but no start. Common cause: fuel air-lock, weak battery, low fuel.
Watch for wet stacking: black oily exhaust. Common cause: running at very low load.
Watch for overheating: shutdown on temperature. Common cause: blocked radiator, low coolant.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
